title: Port-blast victims’ relatives protest at Beirut Palace of Justice on Jan. 10
reason: Reported attendance described as “a few dozen people,” below the 50-person inclusion threshold.
notes: The article reports an actual public protest against delays to the port-blast investigation. This exclusion is for this specific Jan. 10 gathering’s reported size, not for later related demonstrations. Article also reports some protester rock-throwing; state response remains uncharacterized beyond clashes.
